items.coder_A: no candidate (Y-90 microspheres treated as device/radiotherapy); flagged that they could be a radiopharmaceutical
items.proposed: has_eligible_candidate false (agreed coding stands); exclusion reason excluded_intervention_type rather than no_pharmacological_candidate
items.reason: The only intervention is '[DEVICE] TheraSphere GBM', described as 'yttrium-90 (Y-90) glass microsphere therapy for selective internal radiation therapy (endovascular radiotherapy)'. Manual §1.2 lists devices and radiotherapy alone as excluded intervention types; non-targeted radioembolisation microspheres are not a ligand-targeted radiopharmaceutical. Because the trial fails S6 on an excluded intervention type, excluded_intervention_type fits the Figure 1 reason better than no_pharmacological_candidate.

note: Exclusion stands either way. The proposed change of exclusion reason (both coders said no_pharmacological_candidate) only affects Figure 1. XL may want one rule for device-only and radiotherapy-only trials across the dataset (compare NCT04417933, where the coders split on the same question).
